signals.errors.account_paused: LinkedIn warned about the sender account, so Whytide paused it and the run stopped. The next run after the account is connected again or resumed reads on.
signals.errors.account_stopped: The sender account was paused, so the run stopped. Resume it on the LinkedIn page; the next run reads on.
signals.errors.activity_failed: A step of the run failed, so the run stopped. The next run tries again.
signals.errors.insufficient_credits: There were not enough credits, so the run stopped after the work it paid for. After a top-up, the next run reads on.
signals.errors.linkedin_account_disconne: The sender account was disconnected, so the run stopped. Connect it again on the LinkedIn page.
signals.errors.linkedin_error_unmapped: The LinkedIn provider failed in a way we did not expect, so the run stopped. The next run tries again.
signals.errors.linkedin_not_found: The LinkedIn page or profile this source reads was not found, or the sender account cannot see it, so the run stopped. Check the source's link.
signals.errors.linkedin_provider_error: The LinkedIn provider answered with an error, so the run stopped. The next run tries again.
signals.errors.linkedin_rate_limited: LinkedIn limited the reads for a while, so the run stopped. The next run tries again.
signals.errors.platform_stopped: The operator stopped every LinkedIn action on this instance, so the run stopped. The next run after the stop is lifted reads on.
signals.errors.research_no_country: This source's audience names no country, so there is nowhere to look. Add a country to the audience of its agent, or to the default audience.
signals.errors.research_plan_failed: The plan for this run could not be written, so nothing was searched. The next run tries again.
signals.errors.research_search_unavailab: No web search is set up on this instance, so this source can find nothing. Ask the operator to add a search provider.
signals.errors.signal_agent_paused: This source's agent is paused, so its sources read nothing. Resume the agent to run it.
signals.errors.signal_config_invalid: This does not fit this kind of source: check the hint under the field.
signals.errors.signal_import_bad_encodin: This file is not UTF-8. Save it as CSV UTF-8 and upload it again.

signals.source_imports.columns: The first row names the columns, in any order: kind, which is required, then url, name, phrase, roles and label. The kind is post, creator, company or topic. A post or a creator needs its url, a company its page's url and its name, a topic its phrase and, if you like, its roles separated by semicolons (author;commenter;reactor). The label is optional. Other columns are ignored.
